scope: All recorded game outcomes are accepted evidence by user instruction, regardless of folder, unless explicitly invalid/obsolete. Nine disabled/stale records remain excluded. No active explicit invalid/obsolete flags were found; age, missing images, and simulator disagreement are not exclusion reasons.
gateCaveat: Current T6 troop lines hydrate baseline class passives. BandsOfSteel/Ambusher/Volley start at tier7. FC requirements depend on FC independent of tier; there is no T11 gate. Hydration alone is not observed effect use.

currentDefinition.description: Increase Attack Damage to Lancers by 10%

rows.context: Accepted no-hero T6 Infantry-versus-Lancer fixtures support the current normal-damage class-counter contribution: norah_s2_splash_C_nc game1153/1153/1153 versus current1152 and omitted1114; opposite attacking side type_triangle_B_nc game/current -929 versus omitted -922. This is positive contextual support at10%, not proof of all target exclusions, tiers, skill-kind effects, or bucket interactions.

Accepted renee_hendrik_defense_bucket_nc has minxxx full Renee4/4/4 and Hendrik1/0/0 with120 T6 Lancers versus446 T9 Infantry. Game/current+14 versus omission+30 supports the current defender Infantry protection from Lancer normal attacks in this combined kit. No-hero isolation, other targets, skill-kind protection, precise T7 threshold and mixed-tier inheritance remain unreviewed.

currentDefinition.description: The fire crystal energy attached to the surface makes the shield impregnable and grants it X% chance of offsetting 36 damage

rows.context: Accepted FC5 no-hero mixed fixture has 13 observations: current p=0.522674; omit CrystalShield p=0.000100; change level 2 proc from 37.5% to 25% or change the 36 denominator reduction to raw shield 36 each p=0.000050, with 1000 samples per candidate. Supports positive Infantry protection in this normal-attack mixed troop kit and the current probability model over that alternative. Does not uniquely identify exact probability, all denominator grouping, incoming skill-kind behavior, consumption, FC3 level 1 or full gate/target exclusions.

currentDefinition.description: Increase Infantry Defense by X%, and reduce an extra Y% damage while Crystal Shield is active.

rows.context: Accepted FC9 Infantry/Gatot s4/s5 fixtures support aggregate BodyOfLight contribution. Independent 10000-sample s4 confirmation gives current mean 83394.94 SD 218.27 p=0.274036 versus omit only +4 Defense mean 82857.93 SD 227.13 p=0.001550. This supports the Defense effect in the recorded full-kit normal-attack context. Removing only the conditional CrystalShield reduction remains plausible in both cases, so that branch is not positively established. Level2 +6/+15, precise FC8 boundary, skill-kind protection and bucket identities remain unreviewed.

currentDefinition.description: Increase Attack Damage to Marksmen by 10%

rows.context: Accepted no-hero T6 Marksman-versus-Lancer fixture gives game/current +1504 versus omitCharge +1642, supporting defender Lancer normal-damage contribution against Marksmen. Renee full3/3/3 with T6 Lancers versus Marksmen corroborates game/current +50 versus omission -185. Exact bucket equivalence, skill-kind behavior, other tiers and full target exclusions remain unreviewed.

currentDefinition.description: Lancer attacks have a chance to strike Marksmen behind Infantry.

rows.context: Accepted T9 mixed-line fixture has10 game outcomes, mean+179.30 SD2006.64. Current20% with2000 simulator samples predicts -807.72 SD1886.84, combined p0.143893;10% and30% each fail p0.00005; omission is deterministic -5725. This supports the current probabilistic Lancer-to-Marksman targeting behavior over those alternatives, not a precise20% estimate or every gate/retarget interaction. Trial2 has conflicting overall versus per-line counts; retained as recorded, with exclusion sensitivity leaving conclusions unchanged. Lancer-only simple_001_nc is non-discriminating despite exact endpoint and does not add positive Ambusher evidence.

currentDefinition.description: Lancers have a chance to make an extra skill attack for 100% damage.

rows.context: Six accepted s9 fixtures preserve exact T9 versus T1 FC10 Lancer inputs, with IncandescentField and full recorded kits retained. Current level 2 model is plausible in all six (p=0.417979–0.939603); omission fails in each (p=0.000050;1000 samples/candidate). Supports positive outgoing Lancer contribution in this context. Does not uniquely identify the separate skill-job delivery,100% coefficient,15% proc rate, level 1, precise FC boundary or excluded targets.

currentDefinition.description: Lancers have a chance to take half damage when under attack.

rows.context: Six accepted distinct s9 T9 versus T1 FC10 Lancer setups support a joint conditional defensive contribution with CrystalLance retained: independent cross-setup endpoint-residual resampling gives current p=0.728733 versus omission p=0.000460. Each individual n=1 case alone remains compatible with omission. This retrospective inference assumes independent battle RNG conditional on recorded inputs and does not pool different setups as repetitions; no adaptive historical selection adjustment is made. Exact +100% Defense versus another half-damage bucket,15% proc, consumption, level 1/FC8 boundary and skill-kind behavior remain unreviewed.

currentDefinition.description: Increase Attack Damage to Infantry by 10%

rows.context: Accepted no-hero T6 Marksman-versus-Infantry fixture gives game+1623/current+1622 versus omission+1483, supporting its current normal-damage class-counter contribution within the requested1–2 survivor tolerance. This does not establish skill-kind amplification, all target exclusions, other tiers, or bucket interactions.

currentDefinition.description: Marksman attacks have a chance to make an extra skill attack for 100% damage.

rows.context: Accepted s8 T9 Marksman/Gatot fixtures include unresolved 11548 and 25000 tail disagreements. Independent 10000-sample25000 confirmation gives current mean 24962.99 SD 9.40 versus game24929, p=0.001350; replacing normal-job 100% troop damage with a separate 100% skill job worsens p to 0.000050. The 33452 case agrees but cannot distinguish delivery. Omission leaves the one Infantry alive at the 1500-round cap in all 1000 screen samples per setup; score 0 is a draw, not zero survivors. Current/alternative11548 screen each contain one zero-score sample, retained in the raw distribution. This suggests an offensive contribution is needed within the combined model but does not causally isolate Volley or establish its delivery, chance, exact tier7 gate or FC interactions.
